teaser: "Can you just take care of it?" Someone always asks you that, and you always say yes before you've finished hearing the question. Life path 6 is built around that yes — the responsibility that lands on you whether or not you asked for it. ENFJ is built to answer it with warmth rather than resignation, to want the asking itself to feel like being seen. Cross the two and you get someone who does not just carry the load but makes the people watching believe the load was never heavy. The particular thing here is how little daylight shows between duty and devotion. One becomes the other before you notice the seam.
